tools.name: list_formats
tools.description: Lists the 3D model and image formats this connector converts, and which pairs are available. It converts 3D models, and images to images. It does not convert an image to a 3D model. formats gives each id a category of 3d or image. STEP (.step and .stp) is an input and is not an output. SKP, IGES, 3D

tools.name: start_conversion
tools.description: Starts a 3D model conversion or an image-to-image conversion. It does not convert an image to a 3D model. The file comes from a public http or https URL, or from an uploaded file. tools.name: create_upload_link
tools.description: Creates a single-use upload link for one file. The link expires after 10 minutes and accepts a file up to 50 MB. page_url opens the upload page. The file name is sent with the conversion so the download is named from it.

tools.name: get_conversion
tools.description: Returns the status of a conversion. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_formats · Private data: list_formats, delete_conversion, start_conversion, create_upload_link, get_conversion · Public sink: create_upload_link · Destructive: delete_conversion, get_conversion.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_formats · Private data: list_formats, delete_conversion, start_conversion, create_upload_link, get_conversion · Public sink: create_upload_link · Destructive: delete_conversion, get_conversion

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
